educational_notice.en: These lessons are for general education and awareness. They are not a substitute for the current laws of Rwanda, official road signs, professional instruction or directions from authorised traffic officers. Laws and regulations may change. Always check the latest official publications.
educational_notice.rw: Aya masomo agamije uburezi no kongera ubumenyi rusange. Ntisimbura amategeko y'u Rwanda agezweho, ibyapa byemewe, inyigisho zitangwa n'ababifitiye ububasha cyangwa amabwiriza y'abashinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda. Amategeko n'amabwiriza bishobora guhinduka. Buri gihe genzura inyandiko nshya zemewe.

sources.title: Law No. 014/2026 of 06/03/2026 Governing Road Traffic - Official Gazette
sources.publisher: Republic of Rwanda, Ministry of Justice

sources.title: Rwanda National Police - Road Safety Information
World Health Organization - Road Traffic Injuries

title.rw: Intangiriro ku Mutekano wo mu Muhanda

description.en: Understand road safety, the people who use roads and the shared responsibility of preventing crashes.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa n'umutekano wo mu muhanda, abantu bawukoresha n'inshingano buri wese afite mu gukumira impanuka.

definition.en: Road traffic safety is the knowledge, rules, decisions and behaviour that help prevent road crashes and protect people using roads. It concerns drivers, passengers, pedestrians, cyclists and motorcyclists.
definition.rw: Umutekano wo mu muhanda ni ubumenyi, amategeko, ibyemezo n'imyitwarire bifasha gukumira impanuka no kurengera abantu bakoresha umuhanda. Ureba abashoferi, abagenzi, abanyamaguru, abanyamagare n'abatwara moto.

body.en:
A road is a shared space. Different people use it for travel, work, school and trade. Because they share the same space, each road user must consider the safety of others. A safe road user pays attention, follows official signs and signals, respects other people and avoids unnecessary risks.

Before a journey, a driver should check that the vehicle is in safe working condition, plan the journey and allow enough time. During the journey, the driver should remain attentive, keep a safe distance, use signals correctly and adjust speed to the road and weather conditions. Passengers should avoid distracting the driver and should use the safety equipment provided.

Pedestrians should use suitable walking areas and designated crossing places where available. Cyclists and motorcyclists should remain visible and follow the rules that apply to them. Children and other people who may need extra assistance should be given particular care near roads.

Road safety is not only the responsibility of drivers. Everyone contributes by behaving patiently, noticing possible hazards and following lawful instructions. A person who has priority should still be careful because other road users may make mistakes.
body.rw:
Umuhanda ni ahantu abantu benshi bahurira. Abantu bawukoresha bajya ku kazi, ku ishuri, mu ngendo no mu bucuruzi. Kubera ko bawusangira, buri wese agomba kwita ku mutekano w'abandi. Umukoresha umuhanda witonda yitegereza ibimukikije, yubahiriza ibyapa n'amatara byemewe, yubaha abandi kandi akirinda ibyago bitari ngombwa.

Mbere y'urugendo, umushoferi agomba kugenzura ko ikinyabiziga kimeze neza, gutegura urugendo no kwishyiriraho igihe gihagije. Mu rugendo agomba gukomeza kwitonda, gusiga intera itekanye, gukoresha amatara yerekana icyerekezo uko bikwiye no guhuza umuvuduko n'uko umuhanda n'ikirere bimeze. Abagenzi bagomba kwirinda kurangaza umushoferi no gukoresha ibikoresho bibarinda.

Abanyamaguru bagomba gukoresha inzira zabagenewe n'ahantu ho kwambukira igihe bihari. Abanyamagare n'abatwara moto bagomba kugaragara neza no kubahiriza amategeko abareba. Abana n'abandi bashobora gukenera ubufasha bwihariye bagomba kwitabwaho cyane hafi y'imihanda.

Umutekano wo mu muhanda si inshingano z'abashoferi gusa. Buri wese awugiramo uruhare iyo yitwaye neza, yitegereje ibyago bishobora kubaho kandi yubahiriza amabwiriza yemewe. N'ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza agomba gukomeza kwitonda kuko abandi bashobora gukora amakosa.

en: Road safety is a shared responsibility.
Obey official signs, signals and lawful instructions.
Adjust speed and behaviour to road and weather conditions.
Avoid distractions and unsafe behaviour.
Take extra care around children and other vulnerable road users.
rw: Umutekano wo mu muhanda ni inshingano ya buri wese.
Kurikiza ibyapa, amatara n'amabwiriza byemewe.
Huza umuvuduko n'imyitwarire n'uko umuhanda n'ikirere bimeze.
Irinde ibikurangaza n'imyitwarire iteje ibyago.
Witondere cyane abana n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda bashobora guhura n'ibyago byoroshye.

conclusion.en: Safer roads depend on attention, patience, respect and responsible decisions from every road user.
conclusion.rw: Imihanda itekanye ishingira ku kwitonda, kwihangana, kubahana no gufata ibyemezo birengera ubuzima bya buri wese.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson supports quiz questions about road users, shared responsibility and basic safety behaviour.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo rigufasha gusubiza ibibazo bya Quiz Master ku bakoresha umuhanda, inshingano za buri wese n'imyitwarire y'umutekano.

description.en: Learn how road signs communicate warnings, instructions, restrictions and useful information.
description.rw: Menya uko ibyapa byo mu muhanda bitanga imiburo, amabwiriza, ibyo umuntu abujijwe n'amakuru amufasha.

definition.en: A road sign is an official visual message placed near or above a road to guide, warn, regulate or inform road users.
definition.rw: Icyapa cyo mu muhanda ni ubutumwa bugaragara bushyirwa iruhande cyangwa hejuru y'umuhanda kugira ngo buyobore, buburire, butange amabwiriza cyangwa amakuru ku bawukoresha.

body.en:
Road signs help road users understand what is required or what may happen ahead. Signs use shapes, colours, symbols and words to communicate messages. Their exact meaning must be learned from the official road-sign system used in the country where a person is travelling.

Warning signs alert people to possible hazards such as bends, junctions, roadworks, crossings or changes in the road. Regulatory signs communicate rules and restrictions. Information and direction signs help people find places, routes and services.

A driver should notice a sign early enough to respond calmly. Looking at a sign only at the last moment can lead to sudden actions. Temporary signs placed near roadworks are also important and should not be ignored.

If a sign is damaged, hidden or difficult to understand, reduce risk by slowing down when appropriate, observing the road carefully and following lawful instructions from authorised officers. Do not guess the meaning of an unfamiliar sign.
body.rw:
Ibyapa byo mu muhanda bifasha abakoresha umuhanda kumenya ibyo basabwa cyangwa ibishobora kuba imbere. Ibyapa bikoresha imiterere, amabara, ibimenyetso n'amagambo kugira ngo bitange ubutumwa. Ibisobanuro nyakuri bigomba kwigwa hakurikijwe uburyo bw'ibyapa byemewe mu gihugu umuntu arimo kugendamo.

Ibyapa biburira abantu ibyago bishobora kuba imbere, nk'umuhanda ugoramye, amasangano, ahari imirimo, ahambukira abanyamaguru cyangwa impinduka mu muhanda. Ibyapa bitegeka bitanga amategeko n'ibibujijwe. Ibyapa by'amakuru n'ibyerekezo bifasha abantu kumenya ahantu, inzira na serivisi.

Umushoferi agomba kubona icyapa hakiri kare kugira ngo agire icyo akora atuje. Kukibona ageze hafi yacyo bishobora gutuma afata icyemezo gitunguranye. Ibyapa by'agateganyo bishyirwa ahari imirimo yo mu muhanda na byo ni ingenzi kandi ntibigomba kwirengagizwa.

Iyo icyapa cyangiritse, gihishwe cyangwa kitumvikana, gabanya ibyago witonda, ugabanya umuvuduko igihe bikwiye, witegereza umuhanda kandi ukurikiza amabwiriza yemewe y'abashinzwe umutekano. Ntugakeke ibisobanuro by'icyapa utazi.

en: Signs warn, regulate, guide or provide information.
Learn the official signs used in the country where you travel.
Read signs early and respond calmly.
Temporary roadwork signs must also be respected.
Do not guess the meaning of an unfamiliar sign.
rw: Ibyapa biraburira, bigatanga amabwiriza, bikayobora cyangwa amakuru.
Menya ibyapa byemewe bikoreshwa mu gihugu urimo.
Soma ibyapa hakiri kare kandi ugire icyo ukora utuje.
Ibyapa by'agateganyo byo ahari imirimo na byo bigomba kubahirizwa.
Ntugakeke ibisobanuro by'icyapa utazi.

conclusion.en: Understanding road signs helps people make informed and safer decisions.
conclusion.rw: Gusobanukirwa ibyapa bifasha abantu gufata ibyemezo bishingiye ku makuru kandi birengera ubuzima.

quiz_connection.en: Use this lesson to revise the purpose and meaning of different road signs before answering sign-related quiz questions.
quiz_connection.rw: Koresha iri somo usubiremo intego n'ibisobanuro by'ibyapa bitandukanye mbere yo gusubiza ibibazo byabyo muri Quiz Master.

title.rw: Ibyapa Biburira n'Ibyago byo mu Muhanda

description.en: Recognise warning signs and learn how to prepare for possible hazards ahead.
description.rw: Menya ibyapa biburira kandi wige uko witegura ibyago bishobora kuba imbere.

definition.en: A warning sign alerts road users to a possible danger or unusual road condition ahead so that they can prepare and respond safely.
definition.rw: Icyapa kiburira kimenyekanisha icyago gishobora kuba imbere cyangwa imiterere idasanzwe y'umuhanda kugira ngo abakoresha umuhanda babyitegure kandi babyitwaramo neza.

body.en:
Warning signs are used where road users may need extra attention. They may indicate a bend, steep slope, narrow road, junction, pedestrian crossing, animals, falling rocks or roadworks. The sign is an early message to prepare, not a reason to panic.

When a warning sign appears, look carefully at the road and the surrounding area. Consider visibility, weather, traffic and the condition of the road surface. Reduce speed when necessary and be ready to stop if the situation requires it.

Do not overtake where the road ahead cannot be seen clearly or where the manoeuvre is prohibited. Near schools, markets and residential areas, be prepared for pedestrians and other road users to appear. Temporary warning signs should be treated seriously because road conditions may have changed.
body.rw:
Ibyapa biburira bikoreshwa ahantu abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kwitonda kurushaho. Bishobora kugaragaza umuhanda ugoramye, ahamanuka cyangwa hazamuka cyane, umuhanda ugabanutse, amasangano, aho abanyamaguru bambukira, inyamaswa, amabuye ashobora kugwa cyangwa ahari imirimo yo mu muhanda. Icyapa kiba ubutumwa bwo kwitegura hakiri kare, si impamvu yo guhagarika umutima.

Iyo ubonye icyapa kiburira, genzura neza umuhanda n'ibikikije. Reba uko ubona imbere, uko ikirere kimeze, uko imodoka zingana n'uko umuhanda umeze. Gabanya umuvuduko igihe bikenewe kandi witegure guhagarara niba imimerere ibigusaba.

Nturenze ikindi kinyabiziga ahantu utabona neza ibiri imbere cyangwa aho kubikora bibujijwe. Hafi y'amashuri, amasoko n'ahatuwe, ujye witegura ko abanyamaguru n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda bashobora kugaragara. Ibyapa biburira by'agateganyo bigomba gufatanwa uburemere kuko imimerere y'umuhanda ishobora kuba yarahindutse.

en: Warning signs identify possible hazards ahead.
Prepare early instead of reacting at the last moment.
Consider weather, visibility and road surface.
Do not overtake where it is unsafe or prohibited.
Be especially careful near schools, markets and homes.
rw: Ibyapa biburira bigaragaza ibyago bishobora kuba imbere.
Itegure hakiri kare aho gutegereza ko icyago kikugeraho.
Reba ikirere, uko ubona imbere n'uko umuhanda umeze.
Nturenze ikindi kinyabiziga aho biteje ibyago cyangwa bibujijwe.
Witondere cyane hafi y'amashuri, amasoko n'ingo.

conclusion.en: A warning sign gives road users time to prepare and choose a safer response.
conclusion.rw: Icyapa kiburira giha abakoresha umuhanda umwanya wo kwitegura no guhitamo uko babyitwaramo mu mutekano.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson helps you identify the hazards shown by warning signs and select a safe response.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo rigufasha kumenya ibyago bigaragazwa n'ibyapa biburira no guhitamo uko wakwitwara mu mutekano.

description.en: Understand signs that tell road users what they must do or must not do.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa ibyapa bigaragaza ibyo abakoresha umuhanda bagomba gukora n'ibyo batagomba gukora.

definition.en: A regulatory sign communicates a traffic rule, restriction or required action that road users must follow under the applicable law.
definition.rw: Icyapa gitegeka kigaragaza itegeko, ikibujijwe cyangwa igikorwa abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kubahiriza hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.

body.en:
Regulatory signs help organise traffic and reduce conflict between road users. Depending on the official sign system, they may communicate a requirement to stop, give way, follow a direction, observe a speed restriction or avoid entering a restricted area.

The exact meaning of a sign depends on its official design and the law in force. Road users should learn the approved signs instead of relying on guesses or informal explanations. A sign may apply to a particular lane, direction, vehicle type or section of road.

When approaching a regulatory sign, identify its instruction early and follow it in a safe manner. A stop instruction means bringing the vehicle to a complete stop at the legally required place. A restriction should not be ignored simply because the road looks empty.

If an authorised traffic officer gives a lawful instruction, road users should follow that instruction. Temporary traffic arrangements may be used during roadworks or special events.
body.rw:
Ibyapa bitegeka bifasha gutunganya uburyo ibinyabiziga bigenda no kugabanya amakimbirane hagati y'abakoresha umuhanda. Bitewe n'uburyo bw'ibyapa byemewe, bishobora gutegeka guhagarara, gutanga inzira, gukurikira icyerekezo, kubahiriza umuvuduko ntarengwa cyangwa kutinjira ahantu habujijwe.

Ibisobanuro nyakuri by'icyapa biterwa n'imiterere yacyo yemewe n'amategeko ariho. Abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kwiga ibyapa byemewe aho gushingira ku gukeka cyangwa ibisobanuro bitizewe. Icyapa gishobora kureba umurongo umwe, icyerekezo, ubwoko bw'ikinyabiziga cyangwa igice runaka cy'umuhanda.

Iyo wegereye icyapa gitegeka, banza umenye amabwiriza gitanga hanyuma uyakurikize mu buryo butekanye. Itegeko ryo guhagarara risaba guhagarika ikinyabiziga burundu ahagenwe n'amategeko. Ikibujijwe ntikigomba kwirengagizwa kubera ko umuhanda usa n'utemo.

Iyo umukozi ubifitiye ububasha atanze amabwiriza yemewe, abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kuyakurikiza. Amabwiriza y'agateganyo ashobora gushyirwaho igihe hari imirimo yo mu muhanda cyangwa ibirori bidasanzwe.

en: Regulatory signs communicate rules and restrictions.
Learn the official meaning of each sign.
A stop instruction requires a complete stop.
Do not ignore restrictions when the road looks empty.
Follow lawful instructions from authorised officers.
rw: Ibyapa bitegeka bigaragaza amategeko n'ibibujijwe.
Menya ibisobanuro byemewe bya buri cyapa.
Itegeko ryo guhagarara risaba guhagarara burundu.
Ntukirengagize ibibujijwe kubera ko umuhanda usa n'utemo.
Kurikiza amabwiriza yemewe atangwa n'ababifitiye ububasha.

conclusion.en: Regulatory signs communicate instructions that help keep road traffic orderly and safe.
conclusion.rw: Ibyapa bitegeka bitanga amabwiriza afasha gutuma ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda rigira gahunda kandi rikaba ritekenye.

quiz_connection.en: Revise this lesson to distinguish warning signs from signs that impose rules or restrictions.
quiz_connection.rw: Subiramo iri somo kugira ngo utandukanye ibyapa biburira n'ibyapa bishyiraho amategeko cyangwa ibibujijwe.

title.rw: Amatara yo mu Muhanda n'Uko Ayobora Urujya n'Uruza

description.en: Learn the general purpose of traffic lights and the importance of obeying signals.
description.rw: Menya intego rusange y'amatara yo mu muhanda n'impamvu ari ngombwa kuyubahiriza.

definition.en: Traffic lights are signal devices used to control the movement of vehicles, pedestrians or other road users at selected locations.
definition.rw: Amatara yo mu muhanda ni ibikoresho bitanga ibimenyetso bigenzura uko ibinyabiziga, abanyamaguru cyangwa abandi bakoresha umuhanda bagenda ahantu runaka.

body.en:
Traffic signals help organise movement where different directions or road users meet. The common red, amber and green signals communicate different instructions. Their meaning must be understood according to the official traffic rules and the signal arrangement at that location.

A red signal generally means that a road user must stop at the required stopping point. A green signal generally permits movement when the way is clear and it is safe to proceed. An amber signal warns that the signal is changing; road users should respond according to the applicable rules and should not speed up dangerously to pass through.

A green light does not remove the need to look carefully. The junction may still contain pedestrians, vehicles that have not cleared the road or emergency situations. Drivers should not block a junction when traffic ahead is stationary.

Pedestrian signals should also be followed. People crossing should use the crossing area and check that traffic has stopped before proceeding. If signals are not working, road users should slow down, observe carefully and follow lawful directions from authorised officers or applicable rules.
body.rw:
Amatara yo mu muhanda afasha gutunganya urujya n'uruza ahantu hahurira ibyerekezo bitandukanye cyangwa abakoresha umuhanda batandukanye. Amatara asanzwe y'umutuku, umuhondo n'icyatsi atanga amabwiriza atandukanye. Ibisobanuro byayo bigomba kumvikana hakurikijwe amategeko yemewe n'uko amatara yashyizwe ahantu runaka.

Itara ritukura risanzwe risobanura ko umukoresha umuhanda agomba guhagarara ahagenwe. Itara ry'icyatsi risanzwe ryemerera gukomeza urugendo iyo inzira ifunguye kandi nta cyago gihari. Itara ry'umuhondo riburira ko ikimenyetso kigiye guhinduka; abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kwitwara hakurikijwe amategeko kandi ntibihutishe ikinyabiziga mu buryo buteje ibyago kugira ngo barenze.

Itara ry'icyatsi ntirikuraho inshingano yo kureba neza. Mu masangano hashobora kuba hakiri abanyamaguru, ibinyabiziga bitararenga cyangwa ikindi kibazo cyihutirwa. Abashoferi ntibagomba gufunga amasangano igihe imodoka ziri imbere zitagenda.

Ibimenyetso bigenewe abanyamaguru na byo bigomba kubahirizwa. Abambuka bagomba gukoresha ahabugenewe kandi bakareba ko ibinyabiziga byahagaze mbere yo kwambuka. Iyo amatara adakora, abakoresha umuhanda bagomba kugabanya umuvuduko, kwitegereza neza no gukurikiza amabwiriza yemewe cyangwa amategeko abigenga.

en: Traffic lights organise movement at selected locations.
Understand each signal according to official rules.
Do not speed up dangerously when a signal is changing.
A green signal does not mean that it is safe to ignore other road users.
Use extra care when signals are not working.
rw: Amatara afasha gutunganya urujya n'uruza ahantu runaka.
Sobanukirwa buri kimenyetso ukurikije amategeko yemewe.
Ntukihutishe ikinyabiziga mu buryo buteje ibyago igihe itara rihinduka.
Itara ry'icyatsi ntirisobanura ko wirengagiza abandi bakoresha umuhanda.
Witonde cyane igihe amatara adakora.

conclusion.en: Traffic signals work best when everyone understands and obeys them carefully.
conclusion.rw: Amatara yo mu muhanda akora neza iyo buri wese ayasobanukiwe kandi akayubahiriza yitonze.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson helps with quiz questions about traffic signals and safe behaviour at junctions.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo rigufasha gusubiza ibibazo bya Quiz Master ku matara yo mu muhanda n'imyitwarire itekanye mu masangano.

title.rw: Imirongo yo mu Muhanda no Kugendera mu Mirongo

description.en: Understand why road markings are used and how they help organise traffic.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa impamvu imirongo yo mu muhanda ikoreshwa n'uko ifasha gutunganya urujya n'uruza.

definition.en: Road markings are lines, symbols and words placed on the road surface to guide, separate or regulate road users.
definition.rw: Imirongo yo mu muhanda ni imirongo, ibimenyetso n'amagambo bishushanywa ku buso bw'umuhanda kugira ngo biyobore, bitandukanye cyangwa bigire icyo bitegeka abakoresha umuhanda.

body.en:
Road markings provide information that can be seen directly on the road surface. They may separate lanes, show where vehicles should stop, identify pedestrian crossings or indicate areas that should not be used for ordinary driving. Their meaning depends on the official road-marking system and local rules.

Drivers should remain within the appropriate lane and pay attention to lane arrows, boundary lines and crossing markings. A lane change should be made only when it is permitted and safe. Drivers should check the surrounding traffic, signal their intention and avoid sudden movement.

Pedestrian crossings identify places intended for people to cross. Drivers should approach these places carefully and respect pedestrians according to the law. Road markings may become difficult to see in rain, darkness or when the surface is worn, so road users should also observe signs and the general road situation.

Never assume that a road marking can be ignored because there are few vehicles around. Markings help keep traffic predictable and reduce confusion.
body.rw:
Imirongo yo mu muhanda itanga amakuru agaragara ku buso bw'umuhanda. Ishobora gutandukanya imirongo y'ibinyabiziga, kugaragaza aho bigomba guhagarara, kwerekana aho abanyamaguru bambukira cyangwa kugaragaza ahantu hatagomba gukoreshwa mu kugendera bisanzwe. Ibisobanuro byayo biterwa n'uburyo bw'ibimenyetso byemewe n'amategeko y'aho hantu.

Abashoferi bagomba kugendera mu murongo ubagenewe kandi bakita ku myambi yerekana icyerekezo, imirongo igabanya umuhanda n'ahambukira abanyamaguru. Guhindura umurongo bigomba gukorwa gusa igihe byemewe kandi bitekanye. Umushoferi agomba kubanza kugenzura ibinyabiziga bimukikije, kwerekana icyo agiye gukora no kwirinda guhindura icyerekezo gitunguranye.

Ahambukira abanyamaguru hagaragaza ahantu hagenewe abantu kwambukira. Abashoferi bagomba kukwegera bitonze no kubaha abanyamaguru hakurikijwe amategeko. Imirongo ishobora kutagaragara neza mu mvura, mu mwijima cyangwa igihe umuhanda ushaje, bityo abakoresha umuhanda bagomba no kwitegereza ibyapa n'uko umuhanda umeze.

Ntukibwire ko imirongo yo mu muhanda ishobora kwirengagizwa kubera ko ibinyabiziga ari bike. Ifasha gutuma urujya n'uruza rugira gahunda kandi ikagabanya urujijo.

en: Road markings guide and organise road users.
Stay in the appropriate lane.
Change lanes only when permitted and safe.
Respect pedestrian crossing markings.
Look for signs and other road information when markings are unclear.
rw: Imirongo yo mu muhanda iyobora kandi igatunganya abakoresha umuhanda.
Gendera mu murongo ugenewe ikinyabiziga cyawe.
Hindura umurongo gusa igihe byemewe kandi bitekanye.
Wubahe imirongo y'ahambukira abanyamaguru.
Iyo imirongo itagaragara neza, reba ibyapa n'andi makuru yo mu muhanda.

conclusion.en: Correct use of road markings makes movement clearer and safer for everyone.
conclusion.rw: Gukoresha neza imirongo yo mu muhanda bituma urujya n'uruza rusobanuka kandi rukarushaho kuba rutekanye.

quiz_connection.en: Review the purpose of lane lines, arrows and pedestrian crossings before answering road-marking questions.
quiz_connection.rw: Subiramo intego y'imirongo y'imihanda, imyambi n'ahambukira abanyamaguru mbere yo gusubiza ibibazo byabyo.

title.en: Driving on the Correct Side of the Road

description.en: Learn the importance of using the correct side of the road and following lane rules.
description.rw: Menya impamvu ari ngombwa kugendera ku ruhande rwemewe no kubahiriza amategeko y'imirongo.

definition.en: The driving side is the side of the road on which vehicles are legally required to travel in a particular country.
definition.rw: Uruhande rugenderwamo ni uruhande rw'umuhanda ibinyabiziga bitegetswe kugenderamo hakurikijwe amategeko y'igihugu runaka.

body.en:
Countries establish rules about which side of the road vehicles must use. These rules help vehicles travelling in opposite directions pass each other in an organised way and help road users understand where to expect approaching traffic.

Rwanda's Law No. 014/2026 of 6 March 2026 governing road traffic states in Article 4 that the driving side for a vehicle on the road is the right-hand side. Road users in Rwanda should consult the current official law and obey road signs, lane markings and lawful instructions.

Drivers should remain in the correct lane and should not move to another side of the road without a lawful and safe reason. Overtaking is a manoeuvre that requires particular care and must only be done where permitted, where visibility is adequate and where it can be completed safely.

Visitors and new drivers should learn the local rules before travelling. Rules that apply in one country may differ from those in another country.
body.rw:
Ibihugu bishyiraho amategeko agaragaza uruhande ibinyabiziga bigomba kugenderamo. Aya mategeko afasha ibinyabiziga bigenda mu byerekezo bihabanye guhana inzira mu buryo bufite gahunda kandi agafasha abakoresha umuhanda kumenya aho ibinyabiziga bibaturutse imbere bigomba kunyura.

Itegeko ry'u Rwanda n° 014/2026 ryo ku wa 6 Werurwe 2026 rigenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda, mu ngingo ya 4, rivuga ko uruhande rugenderwamo n'ikinyabiziga mu muhanda ari urw'iburyo. Abakoresha umuhanda mu Rwanda bagomba kugenzura itegeko ryemewe rigezweho no kubahiriza ibyapa, imirongo yo mu muhanda n'amabwiriza yemewe.

Abashoferi bagomba kugendera mu murongo ubagenewe kandi ntibimukire ku rundi ruhande nta mpamvu yemewe kandi itekanye. Kurenga ikindi kinyabiziga bisaba kwitonda cyane kandi bigomba gukorwa gusa aho byemewe, aho umuntu abona neza kandi aho bishobora kurangira mu mutekano.

Abashyitsi n'abashoferi bashya bagomba kubanza kwiga amategeko y'aho bagiye gutwara. Amategeko akoreshwa mu gihugu kimwe ashobora gutandukana n'akoreshwa mu kindi.

en: Each country has rules about the side of the road vehicles must use.
Rwanda's Law No. 014/2026, Article 4, specifies the right-hand side.
Follow lane markings and official signs.
Overtake only where permitted and safe.
Learn local traffic rules before driving in another country.
rw: Buri gihugu kigira amategeko agaragaza uruhande ibinyabiziga bigomba kugenderamo.
Itegeko ry'u Rwanda n° 014/2026, ingingo ya 4, rigena uruhande rw'iburyo.
Kurikiza imirongo yo mu muhanda n'ibyapa byemewe.
Renga ikindi kinyabiziga gusa aho byemewe kandi bitekanye.
Banza wige amategeko y'umuhanda mbere yo gutwara mu kindi gihugu.

conclusion.en: Using the correct side of the road is essential for predictable and orderly traffic.
conclusion.rw: Kugendera ku ruhande rwemewe ni ingenzi kugira ngo urujya n'uruza rugire gahunda kandi rwumvikane.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson supports questions about Rwanda's driving side and the importance of following lane rules.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo rigufasha gusubiza ibibazo ku ruhande ibinyabiziga bigenderamo mu Rwanda n'impamvu yo kubahiriza imirongo.

description.en: Learn how pedestrians can reduce risk when walking beside or crossing roads.
description.rw: Menya uko abanyamaguru bagabanya ibyago igihe bagenda iruhande rw'umuhanda cyangwa bawambuka.

definition.en: Pedestrian safety means using roads and walking areas in ways that reduce the risk of being involved in a road crash.
definition.rw: Umutekano w'abanyamaguru ni ugukoresha umuhanda n'inzira z'abanyamaguru mu buryo bugabanya ibyago byo guhura n'impanuka.

body.en:
Pedestrians are road users and must pay attention to traffic. Where a pavement or designated walking path is available, use it. Where there is no suitable walking area, follow the applicable local rules and remain as far from moving vehicles as safely possible.

When crossing, use a designated pedestrian crossing or another legally permitted place. Stop at a safe point, look carefully in all relevant directions and check that approaching vehicles have stopped or that there is enough time and space to cross safely. Never assume that a driver has seen you.

Avoid crossing while distracted by a phone, headphones or conversation. At night or in poor visibility, wear clothing or use items that help other road users notice you. Children should receive suitable supervision near roads, and adults should explain safe crossing habits to them.

Drivers should look out for pedestrians, approach crossing areas carefully and follow the rules that protect people walking. Safe crossing is a shared responsibility.
body.rw:
Abanyamaguru na bo ni abakoresha umuhanda kandi bagomba kwita ku modoka. Iyo hari inzira yabagenewe, ni yo bagomba gukoresha. Iyo nta nzira iboneye ihari, bagomba gukurikiza amategeko y'aho hantu kandi bakagendera kure y'ibinyabiziga bishoboka mu mutekano.

Iyo bagiye kwambuka, bakwiye gukoresha ahagenewe abanyamaguru cyangwa ahandi amategeko abyemera. Babanza guhagarara ahatekanye, bakareba neza mu byerekezo bikenewe kandi bakagenzura ko ibinyabiziga bibegereye byahagaze cyangwa ko bafite umwanya uhagije wo kwambuka neza. Ntibagomba kwibwira ko umushoferi yababonye.

Irinde kwambuka urangajwe na telefoni, utwuma two kumva umuziki cyangwa ibiganiro. Nijoro cyangwa ahantu hatabona neza, ambara imyenda cyangwa ukoreshe ibimenyetso bituma abandi bakubona. Abana bagomba kugenzurwa uko bikwiye hafi y'umuhanda, kandi abantu bakuru bakabigisha uburyo bwo kwambuka mu mutekano.

Abashoferi bagomba kwitegereza abanyamaguru, kwegera ahambukira bitonze no kubahiriza amategeko arengera abantu bagenda n'amaguru. Kwambuka neza ni inshingano isangiwe.

en: Use pavements or designated walking paths where available.
Use designated pedestrian crossings where provided.
Look carefully and make sure it is safe before crossing.
Do not cross while distracted by a phone or headphones.
Drivers must pay attention to pedestrians.
rw: Koresha inzira z'abanyamaguru igihe zihari.
Koresha ahagenewe kwambukira abanyamaguru.
Reba neza kandi ubanze wemeze ko kwambuka bitekanye.
Ntukambuke urangajwe na telefoni cyangwa utwuma two kumva umuziki.
Abashoferi bagomba kwita ku banyamaguru.

conclusion.en: Careful pedestrians and attentive drivers help make walking and crossing safer.
conclusion.rw: Abanyamaguru bitonda n'abashoferi bitegereza neza bafasha gutuma kugenda no kwambuka birushaho kuba bitekanye.

quiz_connection.en: Use this lesson to revise pedestrian crossings, visibility and safe walking behaviour.
quiz_connection.rw: Koresha iri somo usubiremo ahambukira abanyamaguru, uko bagaragara n'imyitwarire itekanye igihe bagenda.

title.rw: Umutekano w'Abatwara Moto n'Ibinyabiziga by'Inziga Ebyiri

description.en: Understand responsible motorcycle use and the importance of protective equipment.
description.rw: Sobanukirwa ikoreshwa rya moto mu buryo burengera ubuzima n'akamaro k'ibikoresho birinda uyitwaye.

definition.en: Motorcycle safety involves responsible riding, a roadworthy motorcycle, protective equipment and compliance with traffic rules.
definition.rw: Umutekano wa moto ugizwe no kuyitwara neza, kuyitwara imeze neza, gukoresha ibikoresho birinda uyitwaye no kubahiriza amategeko y'umuhanda.

body.en:
Motorcycles are useful for transport, but riders and passengers have less physical protection than people inside many other vehicles. Responsible riding is therefore important. Riders should use a properly fitted and fastened approved helmet and ensure that passengers are also protected.

Before a journey, check the tyres, brakes, lights, mirrors and other important parts. Do not ride a motorcycle that has a known safety fault. Follow the speed limits and keep a safe distance from other road users. Avoid sudden manoeuvres, unsafe overtaking and riding on pedestrian walkways.

Never use a phone in a way that distracts you while riding. Do not ride after drinking alcohol or when tired, unwell or affected by medicine that makes riding unsafe. Carry only the number of passengers permitted by law and use the required safety equipment.

Passengers should wear a suitable helmet, sit properly and avoid distracting the rider. Both rider and passenger should respect pedestrians and other road users.
body.rw:
Moto ni ikinyabiziga gifasha mu ngendo, ariko uyitwaye n'uwo atwaye baba badafite uburinzi bungana n'ubw'abantu bari mu bindi binyabiziga byinshi. Ni yo mpamvu kuyitwara neza ari ingenzi. Uyitwaye agomba kwambara ingofero y'umutekano yemewe, imukwira kandi ifunze neza, akareba ko n'uwo atwaye arinzwe.

Mbere y'urugendo, genzura amapine, feri, amatara, indorerwamo n'ibindi bice by'ingenzi. Ntutware moto ifite ikibazo kizwi gishobora guteza ibyago. Kubahiriza umuvuduko ntarengwa, gusiga intera itekanye no kwirinda guhindura icyerekezo gitunguranye ni ingenzi. Irinde kurenga nabi no gutwara moto mu nzira zagenewe abanyamaguru.

Ntukoreshe telefoni mu buryo bukurangaza igihe utwaye moto. Ntuyitware wanyoye inzoga cyangwa igihe unaniwe, urwaye cyangwa wafashe umuti ushobora gutuma utayitwara neza. Twara umubare w'abagenzi wemewe n'amategeko kandi ukoreshe ibikoresho by'umutekano bisabwa.

Abagenzi bagomba kwambara ingofero ibakwiriye, kwicara neza no kwirinda kurangaza uyitwaye. Uyitwaye n'umugenzi bagomba kubaha abanyamaguru n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda.

en: Wear an approved, correctly fastened helmet.
Check the motorcycle before travelling.
Respect speed limits and keep a safe distance.
Do not use a phone while riding.
Never ride when impaired or too tired to ride safely.
rw: Ambara ingofero y'umutekano yemewe kandi ifunze neza.
Genzura moto mbere yo gufata urugendo.
Kubahiriza umuvuduko ntarengwa no gusiga intera itekanye.
Ntukoreshe telefoni utwaye moto.
Ntutware moto igihe utameze neza cyangwa unaniwe ku buryo byakubuza kuyitwara neza.

conclusion.en: Responsible riding and proper protective equipment help protect riders, passengers and other road users.
conclusion.rw: Kugendera kuri moto witonze no gukoresha ibikoresho birinda uyitwaye bifasha kurengera abatwara moto, abagenzi n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson supports questions about helmets, motorcycle checks, passenger safety and responsible riding.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo rigufasha gusubiza ibibazo ku ngofero, kugenzura moto, umutekano w'abagenzi no kuyitwara neza.

sources.title: Rwanda National Police - Motorcycle Safety Information

description.en: Learn why seat belts matter and how passengers can contribute to safer journeys.
description.rw: Menya akamaro k'umukandara w'umutekano n'uko abagenzi bagira uruhare mu rugendo rutekanye.

definition.en: A seat belt is a safety restraint designed to help keep a vehicle occupant in the correct position during sudden braking or a collision.
definition.rw: Umukandara w'umutekano ni igikoresho kigenewe gufasha umuntu uri mu kinyabiziga kuguma mu mwanya we igihe ikinyabiziga gihagaze gitunguranye cyangwa habaye impanuka.

body.en:
Seat belts are an important part of vehicle safety. They help restrain occupants and reduce the risk of being thrown from their seats during a sudden stop or collision. They should be used correctly for every journey, even when travelling a short distance.

The belt should fit properly and should not be twisted. The shoulder section should lie across the chest, while the lap section should sit low across the hips. Follow the vehicle manufacturer's instructions and use suitable child restraints for children according to their age, size and applicable rules.

Drivers should check that passengers are seated safely before moving. Passengers should not distract the driver, obstruct the driver's view or interfere with vehicle controls. Children should be transported using suitable safety arrangements and should not be allowed to move freely in a vehicle.

Airbags and other safety systems do not replace seat belts. They are designed to work as part of a wider safety system.
body.rw:
Umukandara w'umutekano ni kimwe mu bikoresho by'ingenzi birinda abantu bari mu kinyabiziga. Ufasha kugumisha umugenzi mu mwanya we kandi ukagabanya ibyago byo kujugunywa mu gihe ikinyabiziga gihagaze gitunguranye cyangwa habaye impanuka. Ugomba gukoreshwa neza muri buri rugendo, n'iyo rwaba rugufi.

Umukandara ugomba kuba wambaye neza kandi utazengurutse. Igice cyo hejuru kigomba kunyura ku gituza, naho igice cyo hasi kikicara hasi ku rukenyerero. Kurikiza amabwiriza y'uwakoze ikinyabiziga kandi ukoreshe ibikoresho byabugenewe birinda abana hakurikijwe imyaka yabo, ingano yabo n'amategeko abigenga.

Umushoferi agomba kureba ko abagenzi bicaye neza mbere yo kugenda. Abagenzi ntibagomba kurangaza umushoferi, kumubuza kureba cyangwa gukorakora ibikoresho bigenzura ikinyabiziga. Abana bagomba gutwarwa mu buryo bubarinda kandi ntibemererwe kugendagenda mu kinyabiziga.

Imifuka y'umwuka n'ibindi bikoresho by'umutekano ntibisimbura umukandara. Byagenewe gukorana na wo mu rwego rw'uburinzi rusange.

en: Use a seat belt on every journey.
Wear the belt correctly and keep it untwisted.
Use suitable child restraints where required.
Passengers should not distract the driver.
Airbags do not replace seat belts.
rw: Koresha umukandara w'umutekano muri buri rugendo.
Wambare umukandara neza kandi wirinde ko uzenguruka.
Koresha ibikoresho birinda abana igihe bisabwa.
Abagenzi ntibagomba kurangaza umushoferi.
Imifuka y'umwuka ntisimbura umukandara.

conclusion.en: Correct seat-belt use is a simple and important way to improve passenger protection.
conclusion.rw: Gukoresha umukandara neza ni uburyo bworoshye kandi bw'ingenzi bwo kurushaho kurinda abagenzi.

quiz_connection.en: Review this lesson for questions about seat belts, passenger responsibilities and vehicle safety.
quiz_connection.rw: Subiramo iri somo ku bibazo byerekeye imikandara, inshingano z'abagenzi n'umutekano w'ikinyabiziga.

title.en: What to Do When a Road Emergency Occurs
title.rw: Icyo Wakora Igihe Habaye Ikibazo Cyihutirwa mu Muhanda

description.en: Learn general safety principles for responding responsibly to a road emergency.
description.rw: Menya amahame rusange y'umutekano agufasha kwitwara neza igihe habaye ikibazo cyihutirwa mu muhanda.

definition.en: A road emergency is an unexpected event on or near a road that may threaten the safety of people or property and require prompt assistance.
definition.rw: Ikibazo cyihutirwa cyo mu muhanda ni ikintu gitunguranye kibereye mu muhanda cyangwa hafi yawo gishobora gushyira abantu cyangwa ibintu mu kaga kandi kigakenera ubufasha bwihuse.

body.en:
When an emergency occurs, the first priority is to avoid creating further danger. A person who arrives at the scene should stay calm, observe the surroundings and avoid standing in the path of moving traffic. Do not put yourself or others at additional risk.

Contact the appropriate emergency services or local authorities as soon as it is safe to do so. Give clear information about the location, what happened and whether anyone appears to need urgent help. Follow the instructions given by emergency responders.

Do not move an injured person unless there is an immediate danger that makes movement necessary. If possible, keep the area safe and allow trained responders to provide assistance. Do not give food, drink or medicine to an injured person unless a qualified professional instructs you to do so.

Drivers involved in an incident should follow the current legal requirements and instructions of authorised officers. Leaving a scene or failing to provide required assistance may have serious consequences under applicable law. This lesson is general information and does not replace certified first-aid training.
body.rw:
Iyo habaye ikibazo cyihutirwa, ikintu cya mbere ni ukwirinda kongera guteza akaga. Umuntu ugeze ahabereye ikibazo agomba gutuza, kwitegereza ibimukikije no kwirinda guhagarara mu nzira y'ibinyabiziga bigenda. Ntukishyire cyangwa ngo ushyire abandi mu kaga karushijeho.

Hamagara inzego z'ubutabazi cyangwa iz'ubuyobozi zibishinzwe igihe bibaye ngombwa kandi bikimara gushoboka mu mutekano. Tanga amakuru asobanutse agaragaza aho ikibazo cyabereye, icyabaye n'uko hari umuntu ukeneye ubufasha bwihuse. Kurikiza amabwiriza y'abaje gutanga ubutabazi.

Ntukimure umuntu wakomeretse keretse hari akaga kihutirwa katuma kwimuka biba ngombwa. Niba bishoboka, rinda aho ikibazo cyabereye kandi utegereze abakozi babihuguriwe kugira ngo batange ubufasha. Ntugaburire, ngo uhe icyo kunywa cyangwa umuti umuntu wakomeretse keretse ubitegetswe n'umukozi w'ubuzima ubifitiye ubumenyi.

Abashoferi bagize uruhare mu kibazo bagomba gukurikiza ibisabwa n'amategeko agezweho n'amabwiriza y'abashinzwe umutekano. Guta ahabereye ikibazo cyangwa kutatanga ubufasha busabwa bishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga. Iri somo ni amakuru rusange kandi ntirisimbura amahugurwa yemewe yo gutanga ubutabazi bw'ibanze.

en: Avoid creating further danger.
Contact emergency services when it is safe to do so.
Give clear information about the location and situation.
Do not move an injured person unless immediate danger requires it.
Follow the instructions of trained emergency responders.
rw: Irinde kongera guteza akaga.
Hamagara ubutabazi igihe bishoboka mu mutekano.
Tanga amakuru asobanutse ku hantu n'uko ikibazo kimeze.
Ntukimure umuntu wakomeretse keretse hari akaga kihutirwa kabisaba.
Kurikiza amabwiriza y'abakozi bahuguriwe ubutabazi.

conclusion.en: A calm and careful response can help prevent further harm while trained responders provide assistance.
conclusion.rw: Kwihangana no kwitonda bishobora gufasha gukumira ibindi bibazo mu gihe abahuguriwe ubutabazi baje gutanga ubufasha.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson supports questions about emergency awareness, responsible behaviour and road-user duties.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo rigufasha gusubiza ibibazo ku kumenya ibibazo byihutirwa, imyitwarire iboneye n'inshingano z'abakoresha umuhanda.

description.en: Discover what general knowledge means and how it helps people understand the world.
description.rw: Menya icyo ubumenyi rusange busobanura n'uko bufasha abantu gusobanukirwa isi.

definition.en: General knowledge is information and understanding about many subjects, including society, history, geography, science, culture and everyday life.
definition.rw: Ubumenyi rusange ni amakuru n'ubusobanuro ku masomo atandukanye arimo imibereho y'abantu, amateka, ubumenyi bw'isi, siyansi, umuco n'ubuzima bwa buri munsi.

body.en:
General knowledge helps people understand events, ask better questions and make informed decisions. It connects information from different subjects and helps learners see how ideas relate to everyday life.

History explains events and changes that happened in the past. Geography studies places, environments and the relationship between people and the Earth. Science uses observation and evidence to explain the natural world. Civic and social knowledge helps people understand communities, institutions, rights and responsibilities.

A good learner does not accept every statement immediately. It is useful to ask who produced the information, what evidence supports it, when it was published and whether reliable sources agree. Information can become outdated, especially when it concerns laws, technology, public health or current events.

Reading, asking questions, discussing ideas respectfully and practising what has been learned are useful ways to develop knowledge. Learning is a continuous process, not something that ends after one quiz or one book.
body.rw:
Ubumenyi rusange bufasha abantu gusobanukirwa ibyabaye, kubaza ibibazo byiza no gufata ibyemezo bishingiye ku makuru. Buhuriza hamwe ubumenyi buturuka mu masomo atandukanye kandi bugafasha abiga kubona isano iri hagati y'ibitekerezo n'ubuzima bwa buri munsi.

Amateka asobanura ibyabaye n'impinduka zabaye kera. Ubumenyi bw'isi bwiga ahantu, ibidukikije n'isano iri hagati y'abantu n'isi. Siyansi ikoresha kwitegereza no kugenzura ibimenyetso kugira ngo isobanure iby'isi kamere. Ubumenyi ku mibereho n'imiyoborere bifasha abantu gusobanukirwa imiryango, inzego, uburenganzira n'inshingano.

Umuntu wiga neza ntiyemera buri jambo ako kanya. Ni byiza kubaza uwatanze amakuru, ibimenyetso biyashyigikira, igihe yatangiwe n'uko andi masoko yizewe abyemeza. Amakuru ashobora gusaza, cyane cyane arebana n'amategeko, ikoranabuhanga, ubuzima rusange cyangwa ibyabaye vuba.

Gusoma, kubaza ibibazo, kuganira ku bitekerezo mu bwubahane no kwitoza ibyo wize ni uburyo bwiza bwo kongera ubumenyi. Kwiga ni urugendo ruhoraho, ntibirangirira ku kizamini kimwe cyangwa igitabo kimwe.

en: General knowledge covers many areas of life and learning.
History, geography and science answer different kinds of questions.
Check the reliability and date of information.
Use evidence instead of accepting every claim immediately.
Learning continues throughout life.
rw: Ubumenyi rusange bukubiyemo amasomo menshi ajyanye n'ubuzima no kwiga.
Amateka, ubumenyi bw'isi na siyansi bisubiza ibibazo bitandukanye.
Genzura niba amakuru yizewe n'igihe yatangiwe.
Shingira ku bimenyetso aho kwemera buri kintu ako kanya.
Kwiga bikomeza mu buzima bwose.

conclusion.en: General knowledge grows through curiosity, careful reading, reliable evidence and regular practice.
conclusion.rw: Ubumenyi rusange bwiyongera binyuze mu kugira amatsiko yo kumenya, gusoma witonze, gukoresha ibimenyetso byizewe no kwitoza buri gihe.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson introduces the different subjects and learning habits that support the general knowledge quiz.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo ritangiza amasomo atandukanye n'imyitozo yo kwiga bifasha mu kizamini cy'ubumenyi rusange.

description.en: Learn about the Earth, continents, oceans, maps and the relationship between people and places.
description.rw: Menya ibyerekeye Isi, imigabane, inyanja, amakarita n'isano iri hagati y'abantu n'aho batuye.

definition.en: Geography is the study of places, physical environments, human communities and the relationships between people and their surroundings.
definition.rw: Ubumenyi bw'isi ni isomo ryiga ahantu, imiterere kamere y'isi, imibereho y'abantu n'isano iri hagati yabo n'ibidukikije.

body.en:
Earth is the planet on which people live. It contains land, oceans, rivers, lakes, mountains, plains, forests and many other environments. Geography helps explain where these features are found and how they influence life.

The world is commonly divided into seven continents: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, South America and Australia. There are also five commonly recognised oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic Oceans. Different educational systems may group some regions differently, so learners should understand the classification used in their study materials.

Maps represent all or part of the Earth's surface. A map may show countries, cities, roads, rivers, mountains or other features. A map key explains symbols, a scale compares map distance with real distance, and a compass or north arrow helps show direction. Latitude and longitude are used to describe locations on the globe.

Rwanda is a landlocked country in East-Central Africa. Its neighbouring countries are Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Geography also studies climate, population, resources, settlement and how people interact with their environment.
body.rw:
Isi ni umubumbe abantu batuyeho. Ifite ubutaka, inyanja, imigezi, ibiyaga, imisozi, ibibaya, amashyamba n'ibindi bidukikije byinshi. Ubumenyi bw'isi bufasha gusobanura aho ibyo bintu biherereye n'uko bigira ingaruka ku buzima.

Isi igabanywamo imigabane irindwi ikunze kwigishwa: Afurika, Antaragitika, Aziya, Uburayi, Amerika ya Ruguru, Amerika y'Epfo na Ositaraliya. Hari kandi inyanja eshanu zikunze kwemerwa: Pasifika, Atlantika, Indiya, Amajyepfo n'Inyanja ya Arikitika. Uburyo bwo gushyira uturere mu byiciro bushobora gutandukana mu masomo amwe, bityo abiga bagomba kumenya uburyo ibitabo byabo bikoresha.

Ikarita igaragaza igice cyangwa isi yose. Ishobora kwerekana ibihugu, imijyi, imihanda, imigezi, imisozi cyangwa ibindi bintu. Urufunguzo rw'ikarita rusobanura ibimenyetso, igipimo kigereranya intera iri ku ikarita n'intera nyayo, naho ikimenyetso cy'icyerekezo gifasha kumenya aho amajyaruguru aherereye. Imirongo y'ubuhagarike n'ubutambike ikoreshwa mu kugaragaza aho ahantu giherereye ku isi.

U Rwanda ni igihugu kidakora ku nyanja giherereye mu burasirazuba bwo hagati bwa Afurika. Ibihugu bihana imbibi na rwo ni Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi na Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo. Ubumenyi bw'isi bwiga kandi ikirere, abaturage, umutungo kamere, aho abantu batuye n'uko bakorana n'ibidukikije.

en: Geography studies places, environments and people.
The world is commonly taught as having seven continents.
Maps use keys, scales and directions to communicate information.
Latitude and longitude help identify locations.
Rwanda is a landlocked country in East-Central Africa.
rw: Ubumenyi bw'isi bwiga ahantu, ibidukikije n'abantu.
Isi yigishwa kenshi nk'igizwe n'imigabane irindwi.
Amakarita akoresha urufunguzo, igipimo n'ibyerekezo kugira ngo atange amakuru.
Imirongo y'ubuhagarike n'ubutambike ifasha kumenya aho ahantu giherereye.
U Rwanda ni igihugu kidakora ku nyanja kiri mu burasirazuba bwo hagati bwa Afurika.

conclusion.en: Geography helps people understand the Earth's features and the ways communities interact with their surroundings.
conclusion.rw: Ubumenyi bw'isi bufasha abantu gusobanukirwa imiterere y'isi n'uko abaturage babana n'ibidukikije.

quiz_connection.en: Use this lesson to revise continents, oceans, maps, directions and Rwanda's location.
quiz_connection.rw: Koresha iri somo usubiremo imigabane, inyanja, amakarita, ibyerekezo n'aho u Rwanda ruherereye.

title.rw: Siyansi Shingiro n'Uburyo bwo Gutekereza Kiyansi

description.en: Discover how observation, questions and evidence help us understand the natural world.
description.rw: Menya uko kwitegereza, kubaza ibibazo no gukoresha ibimenyetso bidufasha gusobanukirwa isi kamere.

definition.en: Science is a systematic way of studying the natural world through observation, questions, investigation, evidence and explanation.
definition.rw: Siyansi ni uburyo bufite gahunda bwo kwiga isi kamere hakoreshejwe kwitegereza, kubaza ibibazo, gukora ubushakashatsi, gukusanya ibimenyetso no gutanga ibisobanuro.

body.en:
Science helps explain natural events and processes. It includes subjects such as biology, chemistry, physics, Earth science and astronomy. Each field studies different aspects of the world, but all use evidence and careful reasoning.

Scientific investigation often begins with an observation or question. A learner may suggest a possible explanation, collect information, carry out a suitable investigation and examine the results. The explanation should be compared with the evidence. If the evidence does not support the first idea, the explanation should be reviewed.

Biology studies living things, including plants, animals and microorganisms. Physics studies matter, energy, forces and motion. Chemistry studies substances, their properties and how they change. Earth science studies the planet, its materials and natural processes. Astronomy studies objects and events in space.

Reliable scientific knowledge is open to testing and correction. A single observation may not be enough to establish a general conclusion. Repeated investigations, accurate measurements and independent evidence help improve confidence in scientific explanations.
body.rw:
Siyansi ifasha gusobanura ibyabaye n'imikorere y'isi kamere. Ikubiyemo amasomo nka biyolojiya, shimi, fiziki, ubumenyi bw'isi n'ubumenyi bw'ikirere n'ibiri mu isanzure. Buri somo ryiga ibice bitandukanye by'isi, ariko byose bikoresha ibimenyetso no gutekereza neza.

Ubushakashatsi bwa siyansi akenshi butangirira ku kintu umuntu yitegereje cyangwa ikibazo yibajije. Umuntu wiga ashobora gutanga igitekerezo cy'igisubizo, gukusanya amakuru, gukora igenzura rikwiye no gusuzuma ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi. Igisobanuro gitangwa kigomba kugereranywa n'ibimenyetso. Iyo ibimenyetso bidashyigikiye igitekerezo cya mbere, igisobanuro kigomba kongera gusuzumwa.

Biyolojiya yiga ibinyabuzima birimo ibimera, inyamaswa n'utunyabuzima duto. Fiziki yiga ibintu, ingufu, imbaraga n'imigendere. Shimi yiga ibintu, imiterere yabyo n'impinduka zabyo. Ubumenyi bw'isi bwiga umubumbe w'isi, ibiwugize n'ibikorwa kamere biwubamo. Ubumenyi bw'ikirere n'isanzure bwiga imibumbe, inyenyeri n'ibindi bintu biri mu isanzure.

Ubumenyi bwa siyansi bwizewe bushobora kugenzurwa no gukosorwa igihe habonetse ibimenyetso bishya. Kwitegereza ikintu rimwe gusa ntibihagije buri gihe kugira ngo hafatwe umwanzuro rusange. Gusubiramo ubushakashatsi, gupima neza no gukoresha ibimenyetso bitandukanye bifasha kongera icyizere mu bisobanuro bya siyansi.

en: Science studies the natural world using evidence.
Scientific investigations begin with questions or observations.
Biology studies living things.
Physics studies matter, energy, forces and motion.
Scientific explanations can be tested and improved.
rw: Siyansi yiga isi kamere ikoresheje ibimenyetso.
Ubushakashatsi bwa siyansi butangirira ku bibazo cyangwa ibyo umuntu yitegereje.
Biyolojiya yiga ibinyabuzima.
Fiziki yiga ibintu, ingufu, imbaraga n'imigendere.
Ibisobanuro bya siyansi bishobora kugenzurwa no kunozwa.

conclusion.en: Scientific thinking encourages curiosity, careful observation, evidence and willingness to correct mistakes.
conclusion.rw: Gutekereza kiyansi bitera amatsiko yo kumenya, kwitegereza neza, gukoresha ibimenyetso no kwemera gukosora amakosa.

quiz_connection.en: This lesson prepares learners for questions about scientific fields, evidence and basic scientific ideas.
quiz_connection.rw: Iri somo ritegura abiga gusubiza ibibazo ku mashami ya siyansi, ibimenyetso n'ibitekerezo by'ibanze bya siyansi.
